name: KhronosGroup/KTX-Software
description: Official Khronos KTX (Khronos Texture) library and tools for reading, writing, validating, encoding, and transcoding KTX texture files for OpenGL, Vulkan, and other GPU APIs.
score_rationale: Official Khronos implementation for the KTX2 open texture standard with 1.2k stars, actively maintained through 2025, and essential for modern GPU texture pipelines.
summary: Official Khronos KTX2 texture format library for GPU API transcoding
